scripts.package:zip: python3 -c "import os, zipfile, shutil; zf='novashop-complete-project.zip'; z=zipfile.ZipFile(zf, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(os.path.join(r, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, f), '.')) for r, d, files in os.walk('.') if not any(x in r for x in ['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', '__pycache__']) for f in files if not f.endswith('.zip') and f not in ['bun.lock']]; z.close(); shutil.copy2(zf, os.path.join('public', zf)); print('Packaged', zf)"
